method: Hand-written single-best-answer MCQs grounded only in the accepted open full text.

topic.topicDisplayName: Pulmonary arterial hypertension in connective tissue disease: screening, ERA, PDE5 inhibitors
topic.coverageNote: Screening rationale plus ERA and PDE5 evidence are in one review. DETECT score cut-offs are not copied unless stated in the sentences used.

mcqs.question: What survival contrast does the review cite for screening in systemic-sclerosis PAH?

options.A: Better survival when PAH was found in a systematic detection program than when it was diagnosed from symptoms alone
options.C: Symptoms are a more sensitive screen than any test
options.E: Screening is discouraged because PAH is rare and benign

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Better survival when PAH was found in a systematic detection program than when it was diagnosed from symptoms alone
mcqs.explanation: A French program showed improved systemic-sclerosis PAH survival when diagnosis occurred during systematic detection rather than after symptoms alone.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: Open Access Rheumatology: Research and Reviews
sourceRefs.excerpt: improved SSc-PAH-related survival when patients were diagnosed during a systematic PAH detection program compared to those diagnosed on symptoms alone.

mcqs.question: Which drugs does the review list as endothelin-receptor antagonists?
mcqs.explanation: ERAs named are the non-selective antagonists bosentan and macitentan and the endothelin-A-selective antagonist ambrisentan.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: Open Access Rheumatology: Research and Reviews
sourceRefs.excerpt: ERAs include nonselective endothelin-A and B receptor antagonists (bosentan and macitentan) and the endothelin-A specific receptor antagonist, ambrisentan.

mcqs.question: In which WHO functional classes does the review say ERAs may be used alone or combined, versus with parenteral therapy?

options.A: Alone or combined in class II and III; with parenteral therapy in class IV
options.C: Parenteral therapy is required before any ERA
options.D: ERAs are restricted to class IV monotherapy
options.E: Functional class does not affect ERA use

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Alone or combined in class II and III; with parenteral therapy in class IV
mcqs.explanation: ERAs can be used alone or in combination in WHO class II and III, and in combination with parenteral therapy in class IV.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: Open Access Rheumatology: Research and Reviews
sourceRefs.excerpt: ERAs can be used alone or in combination with WHO class II and III patients, and in combination with parenteral therapy in WHO class IV patients.

mcqs.question: What does the review say about tadalafil or vardenafil monotherapy in systemic-sclerosis PAH?

options.A: No such monotherapy studies were known to the authors
options.B: Both are first-line on the basis of large scleroderma-only trials
options.E: They were superior to bosentan in a head-to-head scleroderma trial cited here

mcqs.correctAnswerText: No such monotherapy studies were known to the authors
mcqs.explanation: The authors knew of no monotherapy studies of tadalafil or vardenafil in systemic-sclerosis PAH.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: Open Access Rheumatology: Research and Reviews
sourceRefs.excerpt: no studies have been done on the use of tadalafil and vardenafil as monotherapy in SSc-PAH.

mcqs.question: What did the SUPER-1 post-hoc analysis show for connective-tissue-disease PAH treated with sildenafil?

options.A: Improvement in exercise capacity, hemodynamics, and functional class at 12 weeks
options.D: A mortality increase at one week

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Improvement in exercise capacity, hemodynamics, and functional class at 12 weeks
mcqs.explanation: A post-hoc SUPER-1 subgroup analysis showed improvement in exercise capacity, hemodynamics, and functional class with 12 weeks of sildenafil in connective-tissue-disease PAH.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: Open Access Rheumatology: Research and Reviews
sourceRefs.excerpt: subgroup analysis of double-blind, placebo-controlled SUPER-1 trial showed improvement in exercise capacity, hemodynamics and functional class with 12 weeks of sildenafil use in patients with CTD-PAH
